title: Borrow a Road to Attack Guo
era: Early Spring and Autumn · about 2,700 years ago

source.chapter: Borrow a Road to Attack Guo
source.quote: Between two great states, when the enemy forces the weaker to follow him, I lend him my momentum.

moral: Before you lend anything out, think what he will do with it.
transfer: Think what they will do before you lend it.
